events.title: Brighton & Hove Albion , newly promoted back to the Second Division, sign 바닛 defender Nicky Bissett for £115,000, a record fee for a non-league player. Richard Thompson , 24, becomes the youngest chairman in the Football League when he takes over at 퀸스 파크 레인저스 in place of David Bulstrode .

In the North London derby at White Hart Lane , 아스널 beat 토트넘 홋스퍼 3–2. 사우샘프턴 go top of the First Division after three games with a 2–1 home win over 루턴 타운. 노리치 시티 hold the First Division's other remaining 100% record by beating QPR 1–0 at Carrow Road . Bryan Robson helps 맨체스터 유나이티드 achieve their first goal and win of the season with a 1–0 home win over 미들즈브러 .
Nearly a decade after leaving them for 선덜랜드 , goalkeeper Chris Turner returns to 셰필드 웬즈데이 in a £175,000 move from 맨체스터 유나이티드.
Thijs Libregts makes his debut as the manager of Dutch national team with a 1–0 win over Wales , replacing successful coach Rinus Michels .
Andy Gray returns to his native Scotland after 13 years to sign for 레인저스.

사우샘프턴 drop points for the first time this season with a 2–2 draw against 아스널 at Highbury , and their midfielder Glenn Cockerill suffers a broken jaw in a clash with 아스널's Paul Davis . The result allows 노리치 시티 to go top with a 2–0 win at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, who move to the bottom of the table. 리버풀 goalkeeper Bruce Grobbelaar is hospitalised with meningitis and is expected to be out of action until the new year.
노리치 시티 drop points for the first time this season but remain top of the First Division with a 2–2 draw at home to third-place 밀월.
윔블던 sign 노팅엄 포리스트 goalkeeper Hans Segers for £180,000. 리즈 유나이티드 , fourth from bottom in the Second Division, sack manager Billy Bremner after three years at the helm.
Paul Davis is fined a record £3,000 and banned for nine matches for punching Glenn Cockerill in 아스널's recent League match against 사우샘프턴.

The month ends with 노리치 시티 as the surprise leaders of the First Division, two points ahead of 리버풀 and newly promoted 밀월. FA Cup holders 윔블던 occupy bottom place. The Second Division promotion race is headed by 블랙번 로버스 and 왓퍼드 . 입스위치 타운 , 포츠머스, 브래드퍼드 시티 and 올덤 애슬레틱 occupy the promotion play-off places, while pre-season promotion favourites 리즈 유나이티드 occupy a lowly 18th place.
